description: Owned-site Clarity corpus for property-grouped attention calibration.
claim_scope: Observed traffic corpus; not representative of the average population without demographic sampling and weighting.
split_policy: Assign each property_id to exactly one of train, validation, or holdout.
collection_checklist: Use only owned or explicitly authorized properties with Clarity installed
Export Microsoft Clarity click CSV per site
Capture and analyze the TRIBE session before placing the Clarity CSV to prevent label leakage
Record property_id, page_id, role, unique_sessions, mapped_clicks, and clarity_csv
Run validate_attention_proxy.py --fit-weights --evaluate-holdout only after splits are frozen
